findings.title: Past-watering form and API accept a negative amount of litres
findings.expected: An amount of -5 L is refused with a visible reason (the form's own message says 'greater than zero'), and the API answers 422 for negative litres
findings.actual: The form saves it and shows the success message 'Recorded -5 L on 12 Nov 2026.'. The API also returns 201 for litres -20. The /waterings list then shows '-5 L' and '-20 L', and the total-litres summary disappears because the sum goes negative
